_comment: Platinum's story bosses in play order, each in the split Ian's Level Caps sheet puts it in (My Version RomHack Docs, sheet Level Caps, read 2026-09-22), except that the Galactic fights moved on Ian's rulings of 2026-09-25: Cyrus 2 and Saturn 2 to the HQ split, and Mars and Jupiter at Spear Pillar and Cyrus 3 to the Galactic split. Trainers are Platinum trainer constants, which are also the tr_id every Platinum-based hack's calculator data uses. A rival fight lists all three starter variants; a tag battle lists both opponents. sheet_ace is the sheet's level for the boss's strongest Pokemon, null where the sheet has no row. trick_room marks a fight fought entirely under Trick Room. Tag-battle partners (Cheryl, Mira, Riley, Marley, Buck, Lucas, Dawn, and Barry at the Fight Area and Spear Pillar) fight beside the player and are not bosses; a story tag fight lists its partner's teams, one per starter, under partners. honour_cap is a mini-boss's honour cap (Ian, 2026-10-29 and 2026-10-31), the cap the player keeps to from the split's start until that fight is won, its ace at that cap; beaten is what the fight's script sets on the win (a variable at least a value, or a flag), which the OxiDex reads from a save to know the cap is spent. Tyche and Hermes 1 has none: Barry 4's cap of 42 covers them.

caps._comment: Ian's hard caps. Roark to Candice and the League from his Level Caps sheet (Maylene 39, which he confirmed on 2026-09-22); HQ 60, Galactic 65 and Volkner 68 from his Battle Zone rulings of 2026-09-25, set ahead of the trainers, which the trainer pass brings up to them. Barry 71 from his ruling of 2026-09-27: after the Beacon Badge every fight up to the Elite Four is capped at 71, and 78 holds inside it (the rebuild plays each Elite Four fight at its own ace, since Ian levels only to the next ace). The level-cap design may move any of them.

vanilla._note: Oxide's Lucas and Dawn fights live in slots vanilla leaves unused, so vanilla has no seat for them. Somnu and Moira are Oxide's officers in vanilla's Lake Verity grunt slots, compared with nothing, and so are Tyche and Hermes in the Veilstone and Spear Pillar grunt slots, and Phobos and Deimos in the Jubilife grunt slots.

renegade._note: As vanilla: no Lucas and Dawn fights.

overrides._comment: Where a Platinum-based hack keeps a fight under a different trainer id than Platinum's, fight key to the ids it really uses. Found by comparing names and levels across the hacks' data (2026-09-22), not from their scripts.

redux._note: Redux swapped the two Galactic HQ slots. Its League is at level 100 in several sets (787 to 791, 866 to 870, 874 to 883); 787 to 791 are taken as the first run and the rest as rematches. Unverified until Redux's scripts or docs confirm it.

kaizo._note: Kaizo's League is at level 100 in Platinum's rematch slots, after an 84 Volkner; the first-fight slots hold vanilla's unchanged sets.

milestones._comment: Hacks built on other games line up by position: their Nth gym leader against Oxide's Nth gym fight, their Elite Four in order against Aaron, Bertha, Flint and Lucian, their Champion against Cynthia. ids are the hack's trainer ids, or trainer names where its data has none. A fight the hack has not rebalanced is left out rather than compared. Checked by hand against levels, classes and locations on 2026-09-22.

hardlove._note: Read from the donor ROM, Hardlove 0.6.9. Chuck (47) comes before Jasmine (54) and Pryce (66). The ROM's League is Will, Koga, Karen and Lance as the Elite Four (Lance has the Elite Four class) with Blue (class Champion) as Champion; both of Bruno's slots hold Zubat placeholders. Ian confirmed this League on 2026-09-22.

null._note: Emerald order. Tate and Liza are a tag fight (794, 795) in the Mossdeep Gym. The eighth gym is Ex Leader Juan (272, level 97), as Ian confirmed on 2026-09-22; Leader Steven (804) in the same gym is not the gym fight. The Elite Four's singles sets are used; the rival replaces Glacia.

unbound._note: Difficult mode, bosses only, keyed by name.

run_and_bun._note: From Ian's sheet, keyed by name. Run & Bun's gym order is Brawly, Roxanne, Wattson, Norman, Flannery, Winona, Tate and Liza, Juan, the sheet's tab order. Flannery and Juan are double battles; Tate and Liza are one fight. The Elite Four's singles sets are used.

fights.label: Lucas and Dawn 1
fights.note: Ian's, on Route 202: Dawn or Lucas, one slot for each starter, kept in dummy_ files.

fights.label: Barry 2
fights.note: The tree's ace is 11, one above the sheet.

fights.label: Phobos and Deimos 1
fights.note: Officers Phobos and Deimos, Mars's officers of fear and dread, in Jubilife City beside Lucas or Dawn as the player comes back from Oreburgh, Roark's badge won, so in Gardenia's split (Ian, 2026-10-31: "two more named officers, and to have this pair be the same as the pair fought in Jubilife"). Phobos lowers what the player hits with (Intimidate, Charm, Snarl, Will-O-Wisp) and Deimos lowers how fast they move (Electroweb, Glare, Rock Tomb, Icy Wind, Scary Face). No cap of its own: Mars 1's honour cap of 20 covers it, and its aces are at 18, two under. Lucas or Dawn brings two Pokemon there, the starter at 17 and Pachirisu at 16 (Ian, 2026-10-31: give the partner a real team), so six officers' Pokemon face eight. Made a story fight as Tyche and Hermes 1 is, so goal 3 counts it as one double (docs/oxide/phobos-deimos.md).

fights.label: Lucas and Dawn 2
fights.note: Ian's, on Route 207, met on the way from Eterna to Hearthome (its aces are 30); the route's own split is Roark's, for its lower part.

fights.label: Tyche and Hermes 1
fights.note: Officers Tyche and Hermes at the Veilstone warehouse, a tag battle beside Lucas or Dawn after Maylene's badge, so in Wake's split, its aces at 41 under the honour cap of 42 that runs to Barry 4 in Pastoria (Ian, 2026-10-29; 2026-10-31: no cap of its own). Made a story fight like Somnu and Moira's, so goal 3 counts it as one double (Ian, 2026-10-29: "Let's just fix this now").

fights.label: Barry 4
fights.note: Barry in Pastoria City, before Wake's gym, with an honour cap of 42 and his ace at it (Ian, 2026-10-31: "it will be an intermediate split of 42").

fights.label: Cyrus 1
fights.note: Cyrus in the Celestic ruins closes the first stretch of Byron's split with an honour cap of 47, his ace at it (Ian, 2026-10-31, taking 47 and 50 over the Level Caps sheet's 45 and 49).

fights.label: Phobos and Deimos 2
fights.note: Two Galactic officers in Pal Park's lobby, a tag battle beside Lucas or Dawn once Oak's first-entry scene is over, which makes Pal Park required in Byron's split; Barry 5 on Canalave's bridge waits for its win (Ian, 2026-10-31: "a partner-double fight with lucas/dawn against a galactic double similar to veilstone and jubilife"). It sits in Barry 5's stretch, under his honour cap of 50, with no cap of its own. The officers are Phobos and Deimos, the Jubilife pair grown on (Ian, 2026-10-31), in free slots 9 and 50: five each, both aces at 48, two under the cap, Intimidate and stat drops for Phobos, Sticky Web and Speed drops for Deimos (docs/oxide/phobos-deimos.md); the partner's six are the Veilstone partner's raised to 47 to 49, its Scyther evolved into Scizor with a Muscle Band (Ian, 2026-10-31).

fights.label: Barry 5
fights.note: Barry on Canalave's bridge closes the second stretch of Byron's split, the south and Pal Park, with an honour cap of 50, his ace at it (Ian, 2026-10-31). He fights only once the Pal Park double is won.

fights.label: Somnu and Moira
fights.note: Officers Somnu and Moira at Lake Verity, a double against both at once before Mars 2: a named Galactic fight is a boss, and a double against two trainers is one fight (Ian, 2026-09-28). They are Oxide's officers in vanilla's grunt slots, so no reference hack has a seat.

fights.label: Mars 2
fights.note: The tree's ace is 54: Ian's updated team (Test.nds, or his Boss Documentation sheet for Cyrus 3) replaced the one the Level Caps sheet was written for.

fights.label: Saturn 2
fights.note: Ian's ruling of 2026-09-25: the fight opens in a Trick Room that lasts the whole battle and that no move can end, so the slower side moves first within each priority bracket.

fights.label: Tyche and Hermes 2
fights.note: Officers Tyche and Hermes at Spear Pillar, a double against both at once before Mars and Jupiter; the script starts it with both opponents and no partner. A story fight like Somnu and Moira's, so goal 3 counts it as one double (Ian, 2026-10-29).

fights.label: Cyrus 3
fights.note: The tree's ace is 59: Ian's updated team (Test.nds, or his Boss Documentation sheet for Cyrus 3) replaced the one the Level Caps sheet was written for.

fights.label: Flint and Volkner
fights.note: The Fight Area's tag fight beside Barry. The player reaches the Fight Area after Galactic HQ, but the fight waits for the Beacon Badge (the main track's 3a3472432), so it opens the Barry split (Ian, 2026-09-27); the Platinum hacks keep it post-game and have no seat for it. Ian made it one story fight like Spear Pillar (2026-09-27).

fights.label: Lucas and Dawn 3
fights.note: Ian's, at the start of Victory Road (Victory Road 1F's script, since the main track's 3a3472432).
